company.shortDescription: Contentsquare is an AI platform that provides product analytics, customer feedback, digital experience analytics, and monitoring services.
company.description: Contentsquare is an AI-powered platform that provides rich and contextual insight through customer behaviors, feelings, and intent. aiResearchSummary.text: Contentsquare is researching and developing systems for digital experience analytics, including methods for automatic snapshot selection and zone creation, frustration scoring systems, interactive heatmaps for websites, unsupervised user segment discovery, and real-time alerting systems. Their work also covers session replay with multiple browser tabs, product exposure metrics, and techniques for providing event streams and analytics for activity on websites, highlighting a focus on user behavior analysis, website optimization, and customer feedback integration.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series F round raised $400,000,000, or 28.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $62,503,324 to $5,600,000,000, a 89.6x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
